how: @hyperframes/shader-transitions package; scenes captured with html2canvas. Rules: no 'transparent' keyword in gradients (use target color at 0 alpha), no gradients on <4px elements, no var() during capture, gradient opacity >=0.15, explicit .scene background matching bgColor; don't mix CSS and shader transitions in one piece. Alternative here: hand-written GLSL noise-mask mix(colorA,colorB, clamp(noise+progress*2)).

how: Hard cuts with the speed peak on the cut feel energetic; object transitions without a cut feel premium. Lockup dive: ×1 → ×3.4 in(2) 0.35 s, fade only in the last 0.17 s, thin chrome fades first; incoming letters ×1.9 → ×1 out(3) with 15–20 ms stagger. Size match: a dive with into-bezier (.5,0,.85,.625) 0.58 s where the tile width at the cut equals the next prompt-bar width. Check the cut with QA-X04.

name_en: Object carry contract in screen pixels
what: لنقل عنصر من مشهد إلى آخر يرسم المشهد القادم نسخة مطابقة في المستطيل نفسه على الشاشة ويخفي الأصل تحتها، فلا يرى المشاهد أي قفزة. — To carry an element between scenes, the incoming scene draws an identical copy at the same on-screen rect and hides the original under it, so nothing jumps.
when: بطاقة أو صورة أو زر ينتقل بين مشهدين بكاميرتين مختلفتين — a card, image or button travelling between scenes with different cameras.
how: Agree on screen pixels: screen = 960 + s·(local − 960) with a neutral camera; the outgoing scene reports the element's screen rect, the incoming one draws its copy there. Lift ×1.05–1.12 with a growing shadow over 0.1 s, travel on smooth(), set down. Grow-from-a-point variant: results start at the Generate button centre at ×0.06, fly on arcs, bank −6…+5° → 0, opacity front-loaded over 0.06 s, centre item first, sides +0.06 / +0.12 s.

name_en: Smear, layered-parallax whip and swing pair
what: سوط تتحرك فيه كل طبقة بعامل سفر مختلف فيبدو كتصوير حقيقي، ولطخة تبقى معتمة وهي تعبر حافة الإطار. — A whip where every layer travels by its own factor so it reads as a real camera, and a smear that stays opaque while crossing the frame edge.
when: انتقال سريع بين بطاقات أو شاشات أو مشاهد واجهة — a fast move between cards, screens or UI scenes.
how: Smear ≈ 1150 px with in(2) (≈ 9000 px/s at the end), opaque across the edge, fade only in the last 0.12 s. Whip: wind-up +12 px over 0.14 s, then in(3) to −1500 px in 0.3–0.55 s; travel factors dots 0.5, glow 0.7, type 1.0–1.05, UI 1.1, cursors 1.2 (lead 20 ms); x-blur ≤ 10–18 px. Swing pair: out expoIn 0.36 s / 300 px with 20–24° tilt, in expoOut 0.7 s / 600 px. Mirrored whip: −700 px in(2) 0.45 s / +700 px out(2) 0.45 s (equal speed, EASE-X05). Known failure: 0.14 s whips with 46 px blur and 5–6 empty frames read 'too sharp' → fixed with 620 px over 0.34 s.

how: Morph 1 +18 % size, morph 2 −18 %; in 3D the incoming camera distance D = w·PERSP / w_screen so the copy matches on screen. Worked case: a 47×23 px button rotated 4.3° grows in log size over 0.55 s into an 800×164 pill; colour leads size; the label rolls vertically. Tile → full-frame colour match cut with in(2) 0.45 s.
params: ±18 % size; button→pill 0.55 s log size; tile→frame in(2) 0.45 s

how: Base disc plus 4 radial blobs (r 820–1050 px) drifting on Lissajous paths ±140/±90 px, union of 3 wobbling circles, 420 px feather; radius R = smooth(p)·(distance to the farthest corner + 504 px); an iridescent fringe ring on the edge.

what: طريقتان لتبديل الخلفية بلا تلاشٍ: أعمدة تنسكب من المركز، أو صورة تُضاء تدريجيًا من العتمة بدل لوحة نصية. — Two fade-free background changes: columns pouring from the centre, or a picture brought up from darkness instead of a text plate.

how: Pour: 48 px columns, centre-first stagger 0.02 + hash·0.24 + |i − n/2|/n·0.14, each column 0.34 s, a 6-glyph head. Exposure ramp: brightness(.42) saturate(.9) → 1 over 0.75 s replaces text plates and fades. Plate cuts: hard-cut background plates 3×/s with +6 % drift. Infinite band: overscan +360 px each side (2640 px wide at 1920), no camera swing in that scene, all transitions happen inside the band.

what: دائرة تنغلق على جسم دوار ثم يصبح الجسم نفسه حرفًا في الشعار. — A circle closes onto a spinning object and the object itself becomes a letter of the wordmark.
when: نهاية فيلم تصل إلى الشعار — a film ending that lands on the logo.
how: A vinyl record spins with rotation = distance / radius · 57.3° (rolls without slipping); the clip circle shrinks from 1150 px to the record radius × 0.96; the record becomes the 'o'. Finish fading any masked text before the iris starts.

what: خلل قصير متماثل حول القطع: أشرطة أفقية تنزاح وانحراف لوني يزداد ثم يزول. — A short symmetric glitch around the cut: horizontal bands shift and chromatic aberration swells and clears.
when: 3–4 قطعات فقط في فيلم تقني أو ريل — only 3–4 cuts in a tech film or reel.
how: Triangular envelope g over ±0.07 s; 34 bands; a band shifts when hash > 1 − 0.55·g, by up to ±0.035 of the width, wrapped with fract(); chromatic aberration × (1 + 5g). More than 3–4 per film becomes noise.

what: كل مشهد يحدد نقطة ضوء يخرج منها؛ نغوص فيها فيولد المشهد التالي داخل ذلك الضوء. — Each scene names the point of light it leaves through; we dive into it and the next scene is born inside that light.
when: فيلم أغنية أو قصة متصلة بلا قطع ظاهر — a song film or a continuous story without visible cuts.
how: Each scene function returns its outgoing focus point. Over ±0.42 s scene A is zoomed K^pe (K = 9) about the focus point while the point drifts to centre; a 35 % ghost copy at ×1.08 adds a streak; scene B is masked destination-in by a radial gradient whose radius grows 170 → 1450 px and is drawn at zA/K so it lives inside the focal light; a warm glow follows sin(πp). Good focus targets: a lit window, a point of light, a thread, an ink dot, the evening star.
params: K = 9; half-width 0.42 s; mask radius 170 → 1450 px; ghost 35 % ×1.08

how: Starting the shot after a fly-through larger and shrinking (×5.2 → ×1 after ×12 in) reads backwards; 0.14 s whips with 46 px blur and 5–6 empty frames read too sharp (use ~620 px over 0.34 s); chromatic aberration 0.012·r is far too much (0.0032·r is enough); 4 fixed motion-blur sub-frames look cheap (use adaptive counts, ENG-X01); animated grain on a UI film defeats the dead-air meter and doubles bitrate; opacity-only appearances read as slides; tilting flat UI into 3D to fake depth reads cheap.

name_en: Transition classification by re-synthesis, shipped in-repo
what: لا تخمّن الانتقال من شكل منحنى الفرق؛ ارسم كل نوع مرشح (54 من xfade في FFmpeg + 11 من محررات الهاتف) من الإطارين النقيين قبل وبعد عند 25 قيمة تقدّم، واختر مسارًا رتيبًا بالبرمجة الديناميكية؛ الناتج نوع ومعاملات ومدى ومنحنى تقدّم مقاس يُعاد تشغيله حرفيًا في البناء. — Instead of guessing from the difference curve, render every candidate kind (54 FFmpeg xfade + 11 phone-editor kinds) from the pure frames before and after at 25 progress values and pick a monotone dynamic-programming path; the output is kind, params, exact span and a measured progress curve replayed verbatim in the build.
when: rebuilding a reference edit exactly; identifying what CapCut/InShot/xfade transition a reference used
how: `mm_analyze.analyze(ref, work)` → `spec.json: transitions[{type, params, ts, te, progress, confidence, alternatives}]`; replay with `mm_transitions.render(kind, A, B, p, **params)`. The xfade port is LGPL-2.1-or-later (notice at the top of `mm_transitions.py`); custom kinds need OpenCV or SciPy.
params: score = colour error + gradient error + small complexity prior; 25 progress samples; span grown/trimmed with the same model
install: pip install numpy pillow opencv-python-headless scipy; ffmpeg

what: طابق العناصر بين حالتين بمعرّف ثابت، وحرّك الموضع والحجم واللون للمتطابق، وأظهر أو أخفِ غير المتطابق، فيبدو الانتقال حركة واحدة. — Match elements between two states by a stable id, tween position, size and colour of matches, and fade the rest, so the change reads as one move.
when: شرائح أو شاشات تطبيق أو لوحات بيانات تتغير / slides, app screens or dashboards that change
how: Give each persistent element a data-id in both states; measure both layouts; tween matched boxes (FLIP: first, last, invert, play) with one easing; unmatched: fade 150-250 ms; text that changes content cross-fades in place. Keep durations 0.4-0.8 s; more than ~12 moving matches turns into noise.
